prompt:

COMPOSITION OPTION C — vertical service rail: a narrow, full-height navy navigation rail on the left, about one fifth of the page, contains the exact supplied fox shield at top and vertical destinations “Inicio”, “Revisar SMS”, “Reportar”, “Avisos”, plus a quiet “Gobierno” link at its foot. The remaining warm off-white canvas begins with the exact large question “¿Recibiste un mensaje o una llamada sospechosa?” and one calm line of explanatory text. Below that, give the citizen three large horizontal sign-like destination rows with clear labels and arrows; “Revisar un SMS” is the obvious primary gold destination. At the lower edge, put the modest local-demo note “Demostración local · datos ficticios”. This is a direct service directory, with no large diagram and no dashboard content.

The reference comp contributes the navy/off-white/gold material, directional sign geometry, crisp modern typography, route-label discipline, and spacing quality only. Do not reuse its composition or make a city map. The supplied shield image is the exact logo asset: preserve its silhouette and colors in the rail header, without adding another fox or another emblem. Keep deep navy #10213F, warm off-white #F3F0E6, gold #D5A928. High contrast, precise alignment, broad whitespace. No gradients, stock photography, generic card grid, false alert counts, testimonials, invented capabilities, or claims of active government service. The public task is readable immediately, and core routes remain visible without hover.
